stories.title: Delay continued across the rotation
stories.summary: 3 downstream departures stayed past the 15-minute threshold.
stories.summaryZh: 有 3 个后续航段的起飞延误仍超过 15 分钟。

stories.title: The next flight recovered
stories.summary: 3 late arrivals were absorbed before the next departure.
stories.summaryZh: 有 3 次晚到在下一次起飞前被吸收。

stories.title: Only 15 minutes on the ground
stories.titleZh: 实际地面只停了 15 分钟
stories.summary: The tightest real ground turn was only 15 minutes.
stories.summaryZh: 这条轮转链最短的实际地面周转只有 15 分钟。

stories.title: Delay spread, then recovered
stories.summary: The same aircraft shows why network stress is not a one-way cascade.
stories.summaryZh: 同一架飞机的轮转说明，网络压力并不是单向级联：延误可以传播，也可能在后续航段恢复。
